items.name: Carbine Rifle
items.howToGet: Sold at gun stores after the first few story missions.
items.note: The do-everything gun. If you only carry one, carry this.

items.name: Pump Shotgun
items.howToGet: Sold at gun stores from the start. Police cruisers carry one too.
items.note: Brutal indoors and in alleys. Useless across a parking lot.

items.name: Micro SMG
items.howToGet: Sold at gun stores from the start.
items.note: Shreds up close and fires from a vehicle. The escape artist's pick.

items.name: Marksman Rifle
items.howToGet: Unlocks at gun stores midway through the story.
items.note: For picking targets off before a fight starts. Slow, but it ends arguments.
